newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH CZK 735 MLN 96 AUDITED NET PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: CZECH CZK 735 MLN 96 AUDITED NET PROFIT.

text.p: Czech confectioner Cokoladovny, majority-owned by a consortium of Swiss Nestle SA and France's Danone SA , said on Monday it posted a 1996 audited net profit of 735 million crowns, up from 516 million the previous year.
It added in a statement that the firm's gross operating profit for 1996 grew 46 percent, year-on-year, to 1.39 billion crowns.
"The year 1996 for Cokoladovny was favourable. Compared to the previous year, total sales grew 19 percent to 10.5 billion crowns," the statement said.

"We can say that our markets were favourable, especially in the area of exports...The company, however, is continuing to improve services to customers, innovate production and raise quality," it added.
Cokoladovny is the Czech Republic's largest foodstuffs producer.
The Danone/Nestle consortium holds an 83 percent stake in the firm.
